content: Prisma's typed groupBy/aggregate DSL cannot express multi-dimension time-bucketed aggregation (date_trunc + GROUP BY day) efficiently or at all for some shapes; community consensus + Prisma's own docs (using-raw-sql) recommend prisma.$queryRaw (tagged template, parameterized) for reporting/analytics-style aggregation over groupBy, which is optimized for single-table simple grouping. Raw SQL avoids N+1-shaped round trips groupBy can produce for compound aggregations.
